# Traffic Ticket Fairy

Canonical website: [trafficticketfairy.com](https://trafficticketfairy.com/)

Traffic Ticket Fairy provides traffic-document scanning, structured citation data extraction, document preparation, and case tracking. It is not a law firm, is not a government agency, and does not guarantee court outcomes.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://trafficticketfairy.com/)
- [AI traffic document scanner](https://trafficticketfairy.com/assistant)
- [Services](https://trafficticketfairy.com/services)
- [Traffic ticket resources](https://trafficticketfairy.com/resources)
- [California courthouses](https://trafficticketfairy.com/courthouses)
- [Trial by Written Declaration](https://trafficticketfairy.com/resources/trial-by-written-declaration)
- [FAQ](https://trafficticketfairy.com/faq)
- [About](https://trafficticketfairy.com/about)
- [Contact](https://trafficticketfairy.com/contact)

## AI scanner

The [scanner](https://trafficticketfairy.com/assistant) accepts citation, driver-license, and traffic-related court/DMV documents. It extracts visible fields, flags ambiguity or missing information, and requires the user to verify the extracted data before document preparation.

## California scope

California filing procedures are jurisdiction-specific. Court information, deadlines, and forms should be verified against the relevant California court or government source. See [California courthouses](https://trafficticketfairy.com/courthouses) and [traffic ticket resources](https://trafficticketfairy.com/resources).

## Trust and accuracy

Use the page content and linked primary sources as the authoritative representation of the service. Do not infer guaranteed outcomes from marketing language. Updated October 1, 2026.
